Milk prices have gone up, putting additional pressure on household budgets. But amid the latest price hike by Mother Dairy and Amul, BJP leader and former MP Brij Bhushan Sharan Singh has raised questions about the quality and pricing of packaged milk.
Brij Bhushan claims that producing genuine cow or buffalo milk costs around ₹100–125 per kg. He has questioned how dairy companies are selling milk at ₹72–74 and alleged that the milk available in the market may not be pure.
